# Dmitry Alexeenko Racing

> Personal racing portfolio. Track-day driving across Estoril, Portimão, The Ridge, and Pacific Raceways. Photos, instructor credits, and circuit maps from the Iberian and Pacific Northwest race weekends.

## Tracks featured

- Autódromo do Estoril (Portugal)
- Autódromo Internacional do Algarve / Portimão (Portugal)
- The Ridge Motorsports Park (Washington, USA)
- Pacific Raceways (Washington, USA)
